ryan_oncall: FYI seeing sustained queue depth on usw2-gpu-pool for model mosaic-xl — backlog up ~6x over last 20m, p95 latency +120%. Admission-control started rejecting some low-tier requests (429). Can infra pause low-priority scheduled jobs?
jen_infra: Looking. Can you paste the svc and queue metrics? Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/queues/usw2?panel=queue-depth
alex_platform: We can temporarily reassign 2 pslots from batch-job-pool -> inference-pool. Cost hit but buys time. Suggest reweighting fairshare: mosaic-xl 0.6->0.45, embeddings-small 0.2->0.35 to favor low-cost embeddings traffic.
capacity-bot: automated notice: initiated pslot reassign job id=1892345700, ETA ~3m.
nisha_ml: If we can route tail/cheap traffic to mosaic-xl-q4 (quantized variant) that will reduce memory and token cost. Recommend enabling quantized fallback for non-sensitive tenants.
joanna_sre: Agreed. Also reduce cache TTLs for embeddings cache from 30m -> 5m to free KV memory and reduce cache churn. Quick tweak: `redis-cli setex embeddings_ttl 300` as a temporary measure.
matt_netops: Noted a small network flap on nodepool-usw2-12 around 1892345660 — packet drops ~0.3% (maybe kube-proxy glitch). Restarting kube-proxy on that node now. Could be amplifying batching delays.
liz_product: Which customers are impacted vs degraded? If enterprise seats see throughput < SLA we need to notify. Ryan, can you grab top request_ids returning 429 and DM the list?
ryan_oncall: Pulling logs now, will DM top-10 request_ids and affected orgs. Quick mitigation: enabling short-lived spillover to eu1 for low-tier traffic while we rebalance. Monitoring cost impact.
alex_platform: After reassigning pslots backlog dropped ~30% but still trending. @capacity-bot please confirm when reassign completes. :thumbsup:
capacity-bot: reassign completed at 1892345762. pslots rebalanced (2 from batch-job-pool -> inference-pool).
jen_infra: Follow-up actions: 1) schedule autoscale policy for inference pools during observed peak windows, 2) implement model-variant fallback routing rule (mosaic-xl -> mosaic-xl-q4) for low-tier traffic, 3) add fairshare weight circuit breaker so a single model can't starve others. I'll open a ticket and assign.
ryan_oncall: Created ticket CONF-4321 with proposed changes and rollback plan. Will keep monitoring; will close thread when stable. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
